description: Every valid kernel shipped in v0.1.0 (doc examples of the HexDocs extras and usage rules, examples/ catalog kernels in test/support/examples.ex, and the test suite's kernels where cheap) copied from the v0.1.0 tag into test/stability/0.1.0/, with the results the docs give (iex lines). A test compiles each kernel, checks the recorded results natively, and checks agreement with Elixir mode (assert_agrees on the recorded inputs). The files are never edited: a kernel that stops compiling or changes a recorded result fails mix ci, unless the change is a CHANGELOG-named bug fix (then the test lists it as an explicit, commented exception). Keep the suite fast: stable module names so the build cache hits (see test-output memory), one module per source file. Reuse Defk.LanguageDoc.extract/1 on the tag's files rather than a new extractor. Done when: the corpus is committed, the test runs in mix ci, and a deliberately broken builtin makes it fail (try locally, do not commit).

comments.text: PR #8 opened: https://github.com/DanielLuning/defk/pull/8. Frozen kernel corpus of 0.1.0 (52 files: 44 doc examples with iex results, Examples.Kernels, 7 catalog kernel modules), mix defk.stability.freeze task, test/stability_kernels_test.exs with an empty @fixed exception list, docs/agents/stability.md. mix ci passes; a swapped min/max lowering made 4 frozen examples fail (reverted, not committed).

title: Stability: frozen kernel corpus of 0.1.0 (acceptance and results)
